title: Skewers
summary: The reverse pin: the big piece in front.

steps.text: A **skewer** attacks a valuable piece that must move out of the way, uncovering a piece behind it that you then capture. It is a pin in reverse: the more valuable piece is in front.

steps.hint: Give check on the file where both the king and the queen stand.
steps.success: Re1+! The king must step aside and the rook takes the queen.
